target_name: M&A-announcement SEC Filer/participant within the next 92 days
exact_definition: For the selected issuer feature row, label 1 iff the earliest locally linked DMA/FactSet SEC-filer announcement for that row's valid CIK is strictly after information_available_date (snapshot_ts) and on or before information_available_date + 92 calendar days; otherwise 0.
information_available_date: snapshot_ts = max(datadate + 90 days, rdq) in the protected source panel
selected_feature_row: M11 deterministic GVKEY/fiscal-reporting-quarter row selection, unchanged except the label is no longer max-aggregated
issuer_label: event-recomputed selected-row label; selected-row source label is retained as an exact reproduction check
m11_sensitivity_label: maximum row label across GVKEY/datadate calendar quarter, retained only as a sensitivity comparator
fiscal_cohort_limit: Primary reused-quarter evaluation remains a fiscal reporting cohort. Issuers in one cohort can have different information and forecast-window dates; it is not a same-date portfolio ranking.
common_asof_design: Quarter-end common cutoffs; latest deterministic financial row whose snapshot_ts is on or before the cutoff; labels over the identical subsequent 92-day window.
